jobs.title: Senior Director, Product Management (eIL)
jobs.description:
The candidate leads the strategic vision, roadmap, performance of our Sensor product lines within the eIL Innovation leadership team. This role is responsible for driving the overall sensor product strategy, cross-functional execution efforts, and ensuring the product line meets financial and operational objectives. The role  plays a critical role in shaping the company's overall sensor portfolio and delivering differentiated solutions that meet customer needs and drive business growth.
Central to this leadership role is the full ownership of the function, championing a modernized PLM approach, and maintaining a market-driven mindset.
Key Responsibilities:
Strategic roadmap & portfolio management:
- Define and execute the multi-year global vision for the sensor product line, integrating RFID (HF/UHF/RAIN) and BLE, wireless sensing, and inlay/ label technologies with eIL growth objectives
- Champion a modernized and agile PLM approach to ensure rapid response to market shifts and technological advancements.
- Oversee the product roadmap and portfolio management, ensuring the right mix of products to address market demands and opportunities.
- Analyze market trends, customer requirements, and competitive landscape to identify opportunities for new product development, line extensions, or strategic acquisitions.

P&L & market growth:
- Manage the financial performance of the sensor product line, including revenue and profitability.
- Identify high-margin market gaps, set competitive pricing models,
- Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the success of the sensor product lines and market strategic decisions to optimize the portfolio.
- Support the high level SC planning

Ecosystem & partnership strategy:
- Cultivate strategic relationships across IC design partners, and industry standards bodies (e.g. GS1, RAIN Alliance).

Cross-functional execution:
- Collaborate with and guide the technical development, marketing, technical sales teams and external partners to drive products through stage-gate development to commercial deployment, ensuring seamless integration and execution across the product lifecycle.
- Team leadership & development:
- Scale, mentor, and retain a high-performing product management team, fostering a culture of urgency, accountability, and customer-centric innovation.
- Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement within eIL innovation management team.

Executive advisory:
- Serve as a subject matter expert and thought leader, providing guidance and insights to the executive leadership, cross-functional stakeholders and enterprise customers..
- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field; MBA or advanced technical degree preferred.
- 10+ years of leadership in electronics product management, with proven success managing multi-million dollar P&Ls and global strategies within complex matrix organizations.
- Deep technical expertise in RFID (RAIN, NFC, UHF, BLE), ambient IoT, IC design workflows, sensor packaging and enterprise IoT platforms.
- Entrepreneurial, market-driven mindset with a sharp focus on market dynamics, competitive landscapes, and customer-centric product strategy.
- Strong proficiency in Agile methodologies and data-driven decision-making to drive rapid execution and simplified workflows.
- Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and manage executive stakeholders.
- Assertive, persistent, and highly self-disciplined, with a sense of urgency required to thrive in a fast-paced environment.
- Ability to travel approximately 25% domestically and internationally.
Here's a glimpse of the great benefits you can expect:
- Health & Financial Benefits:  We offer a benefit for the supplemental package of mandatory health insurance, access to Lyra (our confidential Employee Assistance Program) for personal and professional support, a free health check every 4 years, and free fruit on-site. We provide mandatory participation in the Avery Dennison Pension Fund (where the employer pays ⅔ of the premium), along with a holiday allowance and a year-end allowance.
- Time Off & Flexibility:  Annual Leave starts at 24 days, increasing to 26 days after 4 years (pro-rated). You will also receive 13 additional days per year (+4% ATV allowance, pro-rated) and a bridge day off. We offer flexible working hours and hybrid work options for most positions.
- Commuting & On-site Perks:  Take advantage of free and enclosed parking in a well-located building, or opt for a commuting allowance/100% reimbursement for public transport.
- Professional Development:  Invest in your growth with a €500 annual individual training budget, access to numerous internal training and mentoring programs, and a budget for hardware when working from home.

Why join Avery Dennison
We are a global materials science and digital identification solutions company with locations in over 50 countries, and approximately 35,000 employees worldwide. As a science and innovation company, we believe that diverse teams are stronger teams. We are committed to fostering a culture of curiosity and courage, where you can grow your career with a company that has innovation in its DNA. Founded on creating real-world impact to enable a better future, we strive to provide an open, collaborative culture where diversity of thought is encouraged and respected. Hear from our employees about what it's like working at Avery Dennison. Learn more at  www.averydennison.com .
At Avery Dennison, we work with the biggest brands in FMCG, Apparel, Automotive and Pharma industry. Our European Headquarters in the Netherlands, founded in 1955 and since 2014 located in the Leiden Bioscience Park, is a collaborative and dynamic environment that supports all Avery Dennison businesses and employs approximately 500 talented individuals. The location serves as the central hub for European Leadership and other functions that support the wider European manufacturing and distribution network. The location features a state-of-the-art Research and Development Center.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Electronics, PTAP
jobs.description:
ABOUT YOUR ROLE:
A combination of technical marketing and market development role in marketing organization, as the bridge between customer (brand owner, module makers, component maker, converter & distributor) and internal team (R&D, ATS, production, quality, commercial & marcom) to speed up the new market scoping, customer needs clarification and product launch. Improve customer experience and shorten trouble shooting cycle.
YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES WILL INCLUDE:
- Develop and execute overall business strategy for Electronics (Consumer Electronics, Auto Electronics, Display, Semiconductor and Data Center, Electronics Components etc) business in APAC region.

- Investigate and summarize market dynamic/trend, value chain, competitor landscape, customer segmentation. Defines product solution value proposition

- Deep understanding of product management including the ability to connect business and product line strategy in order to drive meaningful business growth via solid new product roadmap development

- P&L ownership for Electronics related product family including portfolio management, pricing strategy, product commercialization

- Drive business growth and profitability with cross functional work including commercial teams and other supporting teams.

- Work with other business divisions as one Avery Dennison global approach for the electronics industry.
WHAT WE WILL BE LOOKING FOR IN YOU:
- Master with 5+ years’ experience or Bachelor with 7+years’ experience related to electronics & product marketing

- Deep understanding for all electronics and electrical industry, experience of material solution or PSA & adhesive application will be a plus

- Familiar with electronics value chain, process flow and customer qualification process

- Good cross functional/regional communication and customer interaction skill

- Good written and spoken English
AVERY DENNISON IS AN EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY PROVIDER. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status or other protected status.
